title: Quick Spicy Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A spicy and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring chicken skewers with a hint of vanilla, this recipe is a quick-fix solution for a delicious meal. It is also FODMAP-friendly and can be prepared in no time.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together vanilla extract, scotch bonnet pepper, garlic-infused oil, lime juice, brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
